notes.title: Octane100 v1.4 is almost ready
notes.content:
[p]Hey guys. Im working on 1.4 version to publish demo as soon as possible and I'm glad to report that the version is 90/100% complete.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459633/172ede049bad1e3a598fb1da7cc1206544855b63.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459633/383ce5465dcf40b74a1680b93e972606ca2251c7.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459633/72ab546247cd5339685ddbad9127fcebea6b1d35.png"][/img]

Some of upcoming features: 

- New Items: TNT, Rucola, Wumbo
- Plants
- Hat bonuses
- Trading terminals
- Badges. (a.k.a Achievements)
- New Locations and UI update.
- Mutators refactoring
- Events[/p][p][/p]
